metadata.coordinateReferenceSystem: WGS84 longitude, latitude in decimal degrees
metadata.coordinatePolicy: Canonical targets copy Natural Earth 5.1.2 1:10m populated-place GeoJSON geometry.coordinates, not the older LONGITUDE/LATITUDE attributes or text-label offsets. Ngerulmud is the explicitly documented Factbook exception. Points represent cities, not municipal or metropolitan extents.
metadata.identityPolicy: ne-<NE_ID> preserves Natural Earth feature identity independently of display-name changes. factbook-plw-ngerulmud is a permanent locally assigned identity for the supplemental capital. Retain IDs across releases and retain old bundles for attempt replay.
metadata.countryPolicy: Existing geography.ts Natural Earth 5.1.2 1:50m de facto map entities and regions are authoritative. ADM0_A3 SSD maps to existing SDS (South Sudan). Other included Natural Earth ADM0_A3 values are retained. City membership is the source association, not a fresh point-in-polygon decision; inclusion and names do not decide sovereignty.
metadata.capitalPolicy: capital=true is the learning subset of national capitals and explicitly identified national government or legislative seats, with capitalRole distinguishing constitutional, administrative, political, royal, legislative and judicial roles. Includes separately mapped self-governed entities without implying recognition. Territorial and autonomous administrative seats are capital=false. Commercial-only capitals (Bujumbura, Colombo), former capitals and Putrajaya (explicitly not the capital in the Factbook) are capital=false. A country with multiple included capital roles has separate canonical city answers; prompts must identify the role, not demand an unspecified single capital.
metadata.curationPolicy: The complete cities array is the curated major-city practice catalogue: supported national-capital targets, selected administrative places in separately mapped territories, explicit role contrasts, and a fixed editorial selection of 94 additional noncapital cities. Noncapital selections span every inhabited continent, mixing familiar global cities and regional anchors. This is neither every settlement nor a population ranking; capital and island administrative-place inclusion is role-based, not a claim of metropolitan size.
metadata.factPolicy: Roles and name notes use the pinned archived CIA World Factbook mirror revision c8cfe21cd019d7748a6b0d57a75d6a77f5ec6ac6, checked against Natural Earth classifications. The archive is not a live authority. Its etymology uncertainty is retained. A specific January 2026 primary-government correction removes Malabo from capital practice. No population, growth or largest-city claims are supplied.
metadata.derivedFactPolicy: Relative-location highlights are computed from the two canonical points: great-circle distance on a sphere with mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km, rounded to 10 km, and initial great-circle bearing rounded to eight compass directions. They are not driving distances. Coordinate-only highlights round the canonical latitude and longitude to one decimal degree.

tolerancePolicy.description: Great-circle radial distance to the canonical point; not a municipal boundary or population-dependent radius.

coordinateExceptions.note: Converted arc-minute coordinates from the archived Factbook capital record; decimal longitude rounded to six places, not a claim of sub-metre accuracy. Natural Earth calls its separate nearby point Melekeok; that point is not relabelled as Ngerulmud.

sourceGaps.reason: Capital designation supported by the 2 January 2026 decree, but no canonical point exists in the chosen Natural Earth release. The older Factbook still gives Malabo; neither its designation nor its coordinates are reused for the new capital.

The archived Factbook explicitly says Nauru has no official capital and locates government offices in Yaren District, but supplies no capital coordinates; Natural Earth has no Nauru populated-place point. No national capital is invented.
Natural Earth has only a single Nicosia capital point associated with CYP. A separate northern-city point is not invented or borrowed from the other map entity.

Natural Earth supplies Ramallah as an administrative place; it is included with capital=false. A separate canonical point for a claimed capital is not supplied by this release, and the Israel-associated Jerusalem feature is not duplicated under another identity.

Bir Lehlou and Laayoune carry claim-specific alternate-capital flags, including an ADM0_A3 association to Morocco for Laayoune. This release does not turn those competing claims into an unqualified national-capital target.
The archive mentions a partial administrative-government role, but the chosen Natural Earth release has no Sejong city point. Seoul remains the capital target.
The archive mentions the Old Royal Capital, but the chosen Natural Earth release has no Cetinje point. Podgorica remains the national-capital target.

limitations: Source retrieval date is not the effective date of every name, role or boundary. Capital relocations, wartime seats and administrative transfers after the archived observations are not inferred.

Jakarta is the capital in the archived Factbook, whose note describes the planned Nusantara relocation. Nusantara is absent from the chosen point source; this bundle does not claim the relocation has completed.
National-capital coverage does not mean every mapped territory has a capital, permanent settlement or city target. Missing territorial seats are not inferred from a parent country’s capital.
Natural Earth administrative labels, scale ranks and population estimates are not treated as current administrative boundaries or population statistics. No city boundary polygons are supplied.
Distinct nearby capital roles can have overlapping 25 km circles. Each question retains its own canonical city identity and explicitly named role; point scoring does not infer a unique municipality.
The Northern Mariana Islands entry is Natural Earth’s Capitol Hill populated-place point, not the centre or extent of the entire island of Saipan.
Source links are provenance only. All city content and coordinates are bundled; reading facts and scoring require no external network.
